screen_description: Onboarding step 3/3. Illustration of document + camera badge. Title: "Upload your pet's passport". Subtitle: "Keep all medical records in one place". Primary button "Take Photo", secondary "Choose from Gallery", text link "Skip for now".
notes: Core hypothesis screen; clear photo-upload primary.

screen_description: Full-bleed photo preview after capture. Shows file size and compression note (3.2 MB → 1.0 MB). Primary button "✓ Upload". Text link "Retake photo". Back cancels to onboarding.
notes: Confirm-upload gate; labeled Upload primary.

screen_description: Centered "Uploading..." with progress bar and MB transferred (e.g. 1.6 / 3.2 MB). Ghost "Cancel" button only — no confirm/upload primary. Auto-advances when complete.
notes: Advances store path; no primary CTA for clarity score.

screen_description: Success flash: large emerald checkmark animation and title "Document uploaded!". No buttons; auto-dismisses to gallery after ~2s.
notes: Confirms medical doc stored; no CTA.

screen_description: PetID empty state. Header "PetID". Folder icon. Title "No documents yet". Body: "Upload your pet's passport, vaccination records, or medical documents". Primary button "+ Upload Document". Bottom nav Pets tab.
notes: Empty→upload entry; clear primary.

screen_description: PetID gallery. Header "PetID". Heading "Documents (N)". 2-column grid of uploaded document thumbnails with dates. Emerald circular FAB with Plus icon (no text label) bottom-right to add another document. Bottom nav.
notes: Shows stored docs; icon-only FAB → medium clarity.

screen_description: Full-screen black viewer of a stored document photo. Back closes to gallery. Prev/next chevrons and swipe hint. Date stamp. Menu opens delete modal — no upload/save primary CTA on the viewer chrome.
notes: Closes value loop (view stored medical photo); no primary CTA.

screen_description: Modal over photo viewer: "Delete document?" / "This action cannot be undone." Secondary-styled full-width "Cancel" button and red text "Delete" below. Removing the document; not an upload/store step.
notes: Delete-only; does not advance store hypothesis. Cancel is clear safe action.

screen_description: Feeding setup screen. Title "Set meal schedule". Fields for breakfast/dinner portions and reminder times. Primary button "Save feeding plan". No mention of passport, medical docs, or photo upload.
notes: Negative: activation feeding path, not PetID upload.

screen_description: Community tips feed. Cards of owner stories ("How I switched food brands"). Infinite scroll; like/comment icons only. No upload CTA, no medical document storage UI.
notes: Negative: social surface.

screen_description: Marketing splash. Logo PetCare. Headline "Everything for happier pets". Subcopy about feeding, walks, and reminders. Primary button "Get started". No medical docs or camera/upload affordance.
notes: Negative: generic start; CTA clear but not upload.

screen_description: Settings → Privacy. Toggles for analytics, personalized tips, share data with clinics. Links to policy PDF. No document upload controls.
notes: Negative: settings.

screen_description: Generic onboarding card. Title "Welcome to PetCare". Body: "Let's set up your household in a few steps." Only CTA is a full-width button labeled "Next". No passport/photo/medical copy on this step.
notes: Negative: vague Next; not upload hypothesis.

screen_description: Map screen "Nearby vets". Pin list with distance. Primary button "Find clinic". Search field for specialty. No pet document upload.
notes: Negative: clinic discovery.

screen_description: Photo of a vaccination card fills the screen after camera capture. Caption "Looks good?". Primary button labeled only "Continue" (no Upload wording). Secondary "Retake". Context implies saving the medical photo but CTA is vague.
notes: Advances upload path; low CTA clarity (Continue).

screen_description: Checkout success: "Order placed!" with food bag illustration and estimated delivery Tuesday. Auto-redirect to home. No documents.
notes: Negative: commerce success flash.

screen_description: After capturing a passport photo, two equal full-width primary-styled buttons stacked: "Share to social" and "Upload to PetID". Same weight, same color. User trying to store medical docs faces competing CTAs.
notes: On upload path but competing equal CTAs → low clarity.

screen_description: Vaccination log form. Fields: vaccine name, date picker, clinic text. Primary "Add date". Explicitly no camera or file picker — typed dates only, not photo upload of medical docs.
notes: Medical-adjacent but not photo-upload hypothesis.

screen_description: Onboarding "Upload passport" copy present, but layout puts a large primary-styled "Skip for now" above the fold and a small ghost "Take Photo" link near the bottom. Gallery option absent. Upload intent is easy to miss.
notes: Advances hypothesis in copy; primary upload action buried → low.

screen_description: Growth screen. "Invite friends, get one free month". Illustration of people with pets. Primary "Share app". Secondary "Maybe later". No medical docs.
notes: Negative: referral.

screen_description: Empty pets list. "No pets yet". Text field for pet name and species chips. Primary "Add pet name". No document/passport upload step on this screen.
notes: Negative: identity setup, not medical photo store.
